title: Decision No 1/2026 of the EU-Republic of Moldova Association Council of 28 May 2026 as regards the establishment of the Public Administration Reform Sub-Committee under the Association Agreement between the European Union and the European Atomic Energy Community and their Member States, of the one part, and the Republic of Moldova, of the other part, and the endorsement of the establishment of the Joint Consultative Committee between the Committee of the Regions of the European Union and the elected local authorities of the Republic of Moldova
text:
Official Journal of the European Union
EN
L series
2026/1766

DECISION No 1/2026 OF THE EU-REPUBLIC OF MOLDOVA ASSOCIATION COUNCIL
of 28 May 2026
as regards the establishment of the Public Administration Reform Sub-Committee under the Association Agreement between the European Union and the European Atomic Energy Community and their Member States, of the one part, and the Republic of Moldova, of the other part, and the endorsement of the establishment of the Joint Consultative Committee between the Committee of the Regions of the European Union and the elected local authorities of the Republic of Moldova
THE EU-REPUBLIC OF MOLDOVA ASSOCIATION COUNCIL,
Having regard to the Association Agreement between the European Union and the European Atomic Energy Community and their Member States, of the one part, and the Republic of Moldova, of the other part (‘the Agreement’), and in particular Article 436 in conjunction with Article 439 thereof,
Whereas:
(1)
Public Administration Reform (PAR) is a fundamental pillar of the enlargement process, and strengthening capacities of the public institutions will be crucial for the Republic of Moldova to advance on its EU integration path, and dialogue and cooperation between local authorities in the Union and those in the Republic of Moldova may provide an integral contribution to the development of their relations and to the integration of the Republic of Moldova into the Union.
(2)
The establishment of a Public Administration Reform Sub-Committee represents an important step forward in strengthening relations between the Union and the Republic of Moldova and enhancing their policy dialogue in this crucial area, and that the endorsement of the establishment a Consultative Committee between the Committee of the Regions of the European Union (the ‘Committee of the Regions’) and the elected local authorities of the Republic of Moldova (the ‘Joint Consultative Committee’) would strengthen direct dialogue between them.
(3)
The Public Administration Reform Sub-Committee should serve as a platform for strategic policy dialogue and should facilitate discussions and coordination on key reforms in the area of public administration and it will play a central role in monitoring of the PAR roadmap implementation and providing guidance to ensure alignment with Union standards and best practices; The Joint Consultative Committee would serve as a platform to share the Union best practices on local and regional governance and matters linked to the implementation of the Association Agreement at the territorial level, thus providing a consistent and stable form of cooperation with the Moldovan local authorities and allowing them to have an active role by co-leading the Joint Consultative Committee and co-shaping its agenda, and issuing recommendations.
(4)
Pursuant to Article 436 of the Agreement, the Association Council has the power to take decisions for the purpose of attaining the objectives of the Agreement.
(5)
Pursuant to Article 439(2) of the Agreement, the Association Council may decide to set up any special committee or body in specific areas necessary for the implementation of this Agreement, and shall determine the composition, duties and functioning of such bodies.
(6)
In order to allow for expert level discussions on the key areas falling within the scope of the application of the Agreement, the Public Administration Reform Sub-Committee and the Joint Consultative Committee should be established,
HAS DECIDED AS FOLLOWS:
Article 1
Public Administration Reform Sub-Committee
1.   A Public Administration Reform Sub-Committee is hereby established.
2.   The Rules of Procedure of the Association Committee and of Subcommittees, set out in Annex II to Decision No 1/2014 of 16 December 2014 of the EU-Republic of Moldova Association Council, shall apply, mutatis mutandis , to the Public Administration Reform Sub-Committee.
3.   The scope of the Public Administration Reform Sub-Committee may be changed by mutual agreement of the Parties.
Article 2
Joint Consultative Committee
1.   The establishment of the Joint Consultative Committee, comprised by an equal number of representatives of the Committee of the Regions, on the one hand, and elected representatives of local authorities of the Republic of Moldova, on the other hand, is hereby endorsed.
2.   The Joint Consultative Committee shall, on its own initiative, carry out its activities with a view to promoting dialogue and fostering cooperation between local authorities.
3.   The Joint Consultative Committee shall adopt its own Rules of Procedure.
4.   The Joint Consultative Committee may submit recommendations to the Association Council.
5.   Expenditure related to meetings of the Joint Consultative Committee, including organizational arrangement, participation of their delegates and support staff, as well as, travel and subsistence expenses, shall be borne by the Committee of the Regions and by the Government of the Republic of Moldova.
Article 3
This Decision shall enter into force on the date of its adoption.
Done at Brussels, 28 May 2026.
For the Association Council
The President
K. KALLAS
